title: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide Derivatives and Their Uses
abstract: A compound, or a stereoisomer or salt thereof, in which the compound has a structure represented by formula III: ** (See formula) ** in which each W1 and W2 is OR5 R5 is (C1-C8) alkyl , alkenyl (C2-C8), alkynyl (C2-C8), carbocyclyl (C3-C8), carbocyclylalkyl (C4-C8), aryl (C1-C8) alkyl, heterocyclyl-alkyl (C1-C8), aryl (C6- C20), heterocyclyl or heteroaryl (C2-C20), and the other of W1 or W2 is; ** (See formula) ** (i) each Rc and Rd is independently H, alkyl (C1-C8), alkenyl (C2-C8), alkynyl (C2-C8), carbocyclyl (C3-C8), carbocyclylalkyl (C4 -C8), aryl (C1-C8) alkyl, heterocyclyl (C1-C8) alkyl, aryl (C6-C20), heterocyclyl or heteroaryl (C2-C20); or (ii) each Rc is H and each Rd is independently (C1-C8) alkyl, (C2-C8) alkenyl, (C2-C8) alkynyl, (C3-C8) carbocyclyl, (C4-C8) carbocyclylalkyl, aryl- (C1-C8) alkyl, heterocyclyl (C1-C8) alkyl, aryl (C6-C20), heterocyclyl or heteroaryl (C2-C20); or (iii) each Rc is H and each Rd is independently (C1-C8) alkyl, (C2-C8) alkenyl, (C2-C8) alkynyl, (C3-C8) carbocyclyl, (C4-C8) carbocyclylalkyl, aryl- (C1-C8) alkyl, (C1-C8) heterocyclyl-alkyl, (C6-C20) aryl, heterocyclyl or (C2-C20) heteroaryl in which the chirality of the carbon to which said Rc and Rd are attached is S; or (iv) each Rc is H and each Rd is independently (C1-C8) alkyl, (C2-C8) alkenyl, (C2-C8) alkynyl, (C3-C8) carbocyclyl, (C4-C8) carbocyclylalkyl, aryl- (C1-C8) alkyl, (C1-C8) heterocyclyl, aryl (C6-C20), heterocyclyl or heteroaryl (C2-C20) wherein the chirality of the carbon to which said Rc and Rd are attached is R; or (v) each Rc is H and each Rd is independently (C1-C8) alkyl; or (vi) each Rc is H and each Rd is independently (C1-C8) alkyl in which the chirality of the carbon to which said Rc and Rd are attached is S; or (vii) each Rc is H and each Rd is independently (C1-C8) alkyl in which the chirality of the carbon to which said Rc and Rd are attached is R; and each R6 is independently (C1-C8) alkyl, (C2-C8) alkenyl, (C2-C8) alkynyl, (C3-C8) carbocyclyl, or (C4-C8) carbocyclylalkyl.
